title: GitHub Actions deploys validated main to production
description:
## Purpose

Implement the repository workflow that deploys the exact validated `main` revision after its required checks and release conditions pass.

## Acceptance

- The workflow can run only for trusted repository events on `refs/heads/main`, never for untrusted pull-request code.
- It checks out and deploys the exact event SHA, builds the web asset, and invokes the existing CDK stack in account 335163751677 / `us-east-1`.
- It uses short-lived GitHub OIDC credentials only; no long-lived AWS secret is stored in GitHub.
- It publishes the branch, SHA, workflow run, stack name, and post-deploy verification result in the run output.
- It fails safely before changing production when required CI/release conditions are not met.

## Dependency

Blocked by SIE-f0d77c, which owns the least-privilege AWS OIDC deploy role. Reuse that work; do not create credentials or an IAM role from this task without explicit approval.
right_now_summary: The deployment workflow awaits the least-privilege AWS OIDC role before shipping validated main changes.
